basis: Lexical allocation/wrapper census reconciled with the handwritten selected dispatch, callback and exclusion argument; not a semantic proof.

startup.argument: Fixed options, selected argv/output copy, predefinitions and initial obstacks; retained-assembler-startup.md and retained-assembler-invocation.md.

hash.argument: Five selected hash tables, callback-allocated controls, arrays and tuples; retained-assembler-hashes.md.

input-buffer.argument: Initial 65539-byte scrub buffer; selected 7410-byte input never reaches resize; retained-assembler-capacity.md and event-check-results.json.

fragment.argument: 924 fragments, 420 payload bytes and per-chain 4064-byte obstack requests; retained-assembler-capacity.md.

symbols.argument: 90 GAS and 104 BFD symbol allocation ceilings, copied names and local conversions; retained-assembler-capacity.md and retained-assembler-startup.md.

expression.argument: Expression-symbol line records within the existing symbol allocation envelope; retained-assembler-capacity.md.

scratch.argument: Unquoted names <=26 bytes and instruction/expression scratch <=67 bytes; retained-assembler-invocation.md.

strings.argument: Quoted file/ident and section strings <=32 bytes; retained-assembler-backing.md.

cfi.argument: One FDE, one state, twelve CFI nodes and one CIE; retained-assembler-backing.md.

fixup-reloc-symbol-output.argument: 279 fixups, 281 relocations, 2248-byte relocation pointer request and 704-byte output-symbol array; retained-assembler-capacity.md.

close-composite.argument: Thirteen fragment-obstack pointers plus terminator: 112 bytes; retained-assembler-backing.md.

optional-sframe.argument: Installed flag_gen_sframe=0 and no enabling option; prior optional six-row SFrame bound is preserved.

wrapper.argument: Notes/hash declarations and implementations forward to the bounded allocators; no independent object count.

input-push-macro.argument: No include, #APP, macro, repeat, local-macro labels or nested input; the empty startup macro hash is separately charged.

floating.argument: No floating numeral or floating-data directive; integer/data forms stay in fixed-width/static-bignum storage.

debug.argument: No debug option, .loc, numbered .file, STABS or CodeView; bare .file uses the ordinary file route.

ecoff.argument: Selected ELF x86 configuration does not define ECOFF_DEBUGGING.

conditional.argument: No conditional assembly directives; the initial conditional obstack is charged separately.

dependency.argument: No dependency option: dep_file stays null and registration/finish return before allocation.

listing.argument: No listing option/directive: listing stays zero and ordinary callbacks return before allocation.

cfi-grouping.argument: No multiple/linkonce/compact CFI grouping; no lazy dwcfi_hash, composed debug names or debugseg records.

synthetic-cfi.argument: flag_synth_cfi stays zero; no ginsn graph, SCFI state or related hash is constructed.

section-extra.argument: No group names, pushsection, link-order target or %S section-name substitution.

option-extra.argument: Selected argv/stream has no listing, definition, MRI/debug remap, architecture or .arch, comment, or help option/directive.

broken-word.argument: Selected WORKING_DOT_WORD x86 target and no .word symbol-difference reconstruction.

clone.argument: No volatile/equated/redefined symbols; dot replacement uses the separately counted location symbol, not an ordinary symbol clone.

folded-name.argument: Symbols remain case-sensitive and the selected target has no canonicalization hook.

large-numeric-label.argument: Only numeric labels 0..4; they use static low counters, and no dollar label occurs.

diagnostic.argument: Selected valid expressions need no symbol-cycle/error-name diagnostic allocation; host diagnostic internals remain an external boundary.

complex-reloc.argument: OBJ_COMPLEX_RELC is absent in the selected target configuration.

compression.argument: No debug section or compression option: write_object_file never calls compress_debug or compression engines.

nonzero-subsection.argument: All subsections and their zero-initialized cached subseg fields stay zero; i386_elf_section_change_hook returns on equality before subsidiary-state allocation.

intel.argument: Selected compiler emits AT&T operands; Intel operand copying is not reached.

unused-inline.argument: No selected caller of xmemdup0, notes_memdup0 or str_hash_find_n; callers present in the corpus belong to excluded macro/debug/listing paths.

quoted-symbol.argument: No quoted symbol names; .file/.ident strings use demand_copy_string instead, already bounded.
